title: 2nd hearing in the Gülşen Tarhan case
paragraphs: The second hearing has been held on charges of defamation against Ege Lensek correspondent Gülşen Tarhan.

According to the indictment, Gülşen Tarhan insulted a public official with reports of a leak in the garbage storage area published on July 12, 2025. The sentence was carried out by the Turkish Penal Code 125 (designation).
The trial was held on February 26, 2026 in front of the First Criminal Court of Emergency. The court adjourned the hearing until May 21, 2026.
In the Gülşen Tarhan case, Attorney Derya Sönmez said the case had not been concluded for two years, asking that the trial be concluded at a reasonable time.
Gülşen Tarhan works as a reporter for Mughla at the Ege Lencek broadcaster. Press occupational organisations have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
The prosecution will present its original debate at the next hearing. Gülşen Tarhan is on trial without arrest.
